<skills_instructions>
## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and a short path that can be expanded into an absolute path using the skill roots table.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `/home/user/agent-skills`
- `r1` = `/home/user/.agents/skills`
- `r2` = `/home/user/agent-skills/.system`
- `r3` = `/home/user/project/.agents/skills`
- `r4` = `/home/user/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote/unity/0.1.8-beta/skills`
### Available skills
- name-only-skill (file: r0/name-only-skill/SKILL.md)
- unity:urp-postprocessing: Sets up, configures, and debugs URP post-processing with the Volume framework. (file: r4/urp-postprocessing/SKILL.md)
- imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas. (file: r2/imagegen/SKILL.md)
- skill-creator: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources. (file: r2/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- backup-db-and-essential: Use when the user asks to back up the pipeline ("faz um backup do banco", "backup do essencial", backup das imagens dos boards, before/after a retag, reindex, bulk job, migration or any risky change to the Asset Manager): snapshots the live asset-manager index.db plus the config, secrets and small hand-made data that git and the caches cannot rebuild, mirrors the assets-board output (paid AI/Tripo generations) into a never-deleting copy, and optionally the previews of catalog-only packs. Also answers what a backup covers, how big it is and how to restore it. (file: r3/backup-db-and-essential/SKILL.md)
- rebase-report: Gerar ou atualizar relatórios de rebase Git em Markdown local e HTML navegável, com decisões, conflitos resolvidos, evidências e prioridades em vermelho, amarelo e verde. Use para documentar um rebase, converter seu resumo em HTML ou destacar os pontos críticos; não é uma skill de execução de rebase. (file: r0/rebase-report/SKILL.md)
- telink-numpad: Knup KP-2008 wireless numpad (Telink 2.4G receiver, USB 248a:8367) turned into a virtual Xbox 360 gamepad for Unity, with a NUM-LED mode toggle. Use when changing its key mapping, debugging keys that type the wrong thing, making a game/Unity project read it as a gamepad, capturing key codes from any input device, or when someone mentions the numpad, keyd, the X360 virtual pad or telink-numpad. (file: r0/telink-numpad/SKILL.md)
</skills_instructions>
